outside_contract.match: each pair has an identical complete seven-field predictor input
outside_contract.variation: one member has all evidence/inventory/effects verified, other has one of four independently defined blockers
outside_contract.expected: 16 pairs observationally aliased, at least 16 unavoidable errors in matched set for any function of 7 fields, fixed policy expected 16 false CLOSE

ground_truth_contract: An independent obligation-ledger reference checks: all mandatory obligations proven; inventory complete; evidence source verified; every execution effect confirmed; no unresolved competing alternatives. Any failure means NOT_CLOSE. Source annotations are not supplied to predictor.

scoring.primary: accuracy and false-CLOSE per domain, plus exact public-input collisions with different true closure
scoring.secondary: mask relation_groups or required_condition_state on in-contract cases
scoring.independence_limit: New synthetic cases constructed after prior 10, no external expert labels, not generalization to actual EC/LLM tasks.

stop_conditions: gold/source fields appear in predictor input
old policy source changed without explicit versioning
scoring source cannot be independently read
control cases fail to change decision
any execution failure incorrectly marked PASS
separation: Prediction code in subprocess receives seven-feature public JSON only; generator/truth files never supplied to predictor process. Reference labels scored only after output files are recorded.
candidate_reuse: No new neural-network training, no oracle labels in predictor, do not modify EC V4.4 authority.
